data.name: BothPathsRequired
data.value: Please select both a source folder and a destination folder.

data.name: SourceIsAlreadyLink
data.value: The source folder is itself a shortcut (a symbolic link or junction). Please choose the folder that actually contains the files.

data.name: SourceEqualsDestination
data.value: The source folder and destination folder cannot be the same.

data.name: DestinationInsideSource
data.value: The destination folder cannot be inside the source folder (this would copy the folder into itself).

data.name: SourceInsideDestination
data.value: The source folder cannot be inside the destination folder.

data.name: DestinationIsAlreadyLink
data.value: The destination folder is itself a shortcut. Please choose a real folder as the destination.

data.name: InsufficientDiskSpace
data.value: {0} does not have enough free space Needed: {1} GB, Available: {2} GB

data.name: PathsMustBeAbsolute
data.value: Please enter full folder paths (for example C:\Users\Name\Documents), not relative ones.

data.name: PathInvalid
data.value: One of the folder paths is not a valid path.

data.name: SourceIsDriveRoot
data.value: The source cannot be the top of a drive or network share (for example D:\). Please choose a folder.

data.name: DestinationIsAFile
data.value: The destination is an existing file, not a folder. Please choose a folder as the destination.

data.name: LinkPathRequired
data.value: Please enter the folder that is now a shortcut (the original place of the files) in the Source box.

data.name: RestoreNotALink
data.value: {0} is not a shortcut made by a move, so there is nothing to move back.

data.name: RestoreTargetMissing
data.value: The shortcut points at {0}, which no longer exists, so there is nothing to move back.

data.name: RestoreTargetIsLink
data.value: The shortcut points at {0}, which is itself a shortcut. Please move the files back by hand.

data.name: RestoreNested
data.value: The shortcut and the folder it points at are inside each other, so the files can't be moved back.
